I'll write it soonish
Might have to work through a few drafts before it's objective and not as heated as what i just sent in the thread myself
What you sent in the thread was pretty good, though.

The last time a TBH Condemnation was repealed, we submitted a scathing IFV criticizing the way its authors had spit in the face of this august body by flaunting tradition and sidestepping any legitimate criticism that could have arrived based on easily refuted excuses. Now, we stand here again facing a proposal that does the same. Equally, The East Pacific opposes this. We do not vote against this repeal because the resolution it targets is of high quality — indeed its quality is rather poor. We vote against because the repeal is no better. We could get into the flimsy substantial arguments and we could concede the strong points it makes between them, but the authors do not want that. If they did, they would have drafted this repeal on the forums.

The Black Hawks is deserving of a condemnation. Of that there can be no question. For years and years it has stood as one of the premier titans of raiding and its double condemnation status was a testament to that. Some argued that it maybe only deserved one. Some argued that one or both were of poor quality. But not until the recent trend of stripping raiders of recognition began did anyone suggest TBH was not worthy of one. In an ideal world, this repeal would be followed by a well-written replacement, which the authors are more than capable of. In that world, TEP might support a repeal and replace.

This is not that world. This is a world where petty R/D grievances rule all aspects of the game, where some military GPers wish to strip their opponents of their badges instead of acknowledging that they are effective foes. TEP will not parrot the raider talking points that this is meant to “make up for” poor performance on the field but we are firmly of the belief that it had no bearing on said performance. With or without this condemnation, the military landscape of this game will not change.
For all these reasons, The East Pacific therefore recommends that all nations with respect for the WA, NS history, and R/D culture vote AGAINST this repeal.
@Aurora, Desuwa of Umapyoi
